title: 200₹ Karolbagh Food Challenge 🔥😍 #shorts #food
description:
Hello everyone recently I visited Karol Bagh and did ₹200 food challenge ￼
1. I tried most viral aunty pasta which cost me ₹50 for half plate and the taste was very bad ￼
2. I tried most famous kB chaat Moonglate which cost me ₹100￼￼ and the taste was super delicious
3. last we tried mango shake which cost me ₹50 and the taste was yummy￼

I hope you like the video if yes then don’t forget to like, share and subscribe the channel.!
